biotools.summary: PoweREST is a web application and associated tool for statistical power estimation in spatial transcriptomics experiments. It supports calculation of power for detecting differentially expressed genes, particularly for 10X Genomics Visium data, through bootstrap resampling and provides interactive visualization of results.
